codeReview.summary: The Application god struct was cleanly decomposed into EditorState (13 editor-cfg-gated fields) and DebugState (2 debug-assertion fields). The Application struct now has a single #[cfg(feature = 'editor')] editor: EditorState field and a single #[cfg(debug_assertions)] debug: DebugState field. All 15 scattered per-field cfg annotations have been eliminated from the Application struct. All field access sites across 8 files (mod.rs, renderer.rs, picking.rs, init.rs, gizmo.rs, frame_loop.rs, editor/mod.rs, builder.rs) were updated to use the new sub-struct paths. All 202 workspace tests pass, non-editor build compiles, and release build compiles.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The handoff ran 'cargo check -p katla_app --release' for release build verification, but services.yaml has no 'check_release' command. This configuration gap means future workers may not know to verify release builds when touching debug_assertions-gated code.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff verification shows 'cargo check -p katla_app --release' was run, but .factory/services.yaml does not include this command.
